_source.title: 获取工程目录路径
_source.remarks.text.0: 注意 1：本接口仅半、全离线客户端有效，在浏览器环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意 2：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Get the project directory paths
remarks.text.0: Note 1: This API is only valid for semi-offline and fully offline clients. Calling it in a browser environment will always `throw Error`
remarks.text.1: Note 2: This API requires the user to enable the extension external interaction permission, if not enabled, it will always `throw Error`
